context: Two managers prep a small-business outreach plan
purpose: Teach: 多用/却下/零細/撤廃/利権/啓蒙/弾力/類型

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 来週の零細事業者向け説明会の資料、最終確認しよう。
lines.en: Let's do a final check on the materials for next week's small-business briefing.
lines.style: Efficient and focused. Slight forward lean in the voice. Matter-of-fact, like settling into work mode together. Direct eye contact implied.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: スライドの専門用語、極力多用を避ける構成にしてあります。
lines.en: I've structured the slides to minimize jargon as much as possible.
lines.style: Calm, methodical delivery. Quiet confidence in the groundwork. A slight gesture toward the screen or document. Measured pace, no rush.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: いいね。質疑応答の弾力性も上げておきたい。
lines.en: Good. I want to build more flexibility into the Q&A segment too.
lines.style: Warm approval on the opening word. Quickly refocusing—pen poised over the agenda. Businesslike but collaborative tone. Slight lift at the end, inviting input.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 過去の却下事例、類型化して付録に入れました。
lines.en: I've categorized the past rejection cases and added them to the appendix.
lines.style: Steady, detail-oriented delivery. Understated pride beneath the surface—showing off the work without saying so. Even pacing, slightly slower for weight. Small pause before the final phrase.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 啓蒙という言葉、人によって硬く響くから、別の表現に置き換えよう。
lines.en: The word 'enlightenment' sounds too stiff for some people. Let's find something softer.
lines.style: Thoughtful, collaborative edit. Slight pause before 'stiff'—thinking aloud. Gentle, not critical. Tone suggests invitation to brainstorm rather than directive.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 「お役立ち情報」あたりが無難ですかね。
lines.en: Something like 'useful information' would be safer, wouldn't it?
lines.style: Cooperative and tentative. Slight upward inflection at the end—offering, not asserting. Quiet, measured pace. The tone of a junior checking in with a senior whose judgment he trusts.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: それで。利権の話には深入りせず、規制の撤廃案だけ淡々と伝えよう。
lines.en: Exactly. Don't get into the vested-interest angle—just present the deregulation proposal straightforwardly.
lines.style: Pragmatic and decisive. Brisk clip on 'exactly.' Sharp focus on priorities. Team-lead confidence without harshness. The voice of someone who's thought this through.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 了解です。配布資料、印刷上がり次第お持ちします。
lines.en: Got it. I'll bring the handouts once they come off the press.
lines.style: Crisp, professional closer. Quick and assured. No lingering—the meeting is winding down smoothly. Light, efficient energy.
